message: Hey John, I stumbled upon our old conversations. It's hard to believe how much has changed since then.
John, I just can't shake off this feeling of sadness. Mom and Dad's divorce is really hitting me hard.
I miss the times when we were all together. It's been tough dealing with this alone.
John, I wish I could make things better for you. Just know that I'm here for you, okay?
Do you remember when Dad used to take us fishing on weekends? I miss those days.
John, I found some old photos of us with Mom and Dad. It made me smile and cry at the same time.
I hope we can get through this together, John. I hate seeing you like this.
John, I'm sorry if I've been distant lately. I'm just struggling to cope with everything.
I love you, John. Hang in there, okay? We'll get through this.
Hey John, just wanted to check in on you. How are you feeling today?
